# BADGRTechnologies

BADGRTechnologies LLC is a Georgia LLC based in Lawrenceville, Gwinnett County, Georgia, serving Gwinnett County and metro Atlanta. It improves existing websites for local small businesses, locally and remotely across the U.S. Medical, dental, therapy, home-service, and other local businesses are welcome.

Primary services:
- Free Website Check ($0): one public page, up to three observed issues by email
- Website Tune-Up ($349 one-time): up to three public pages; mobile speed and layout, page titles and descriptions, broken links, one contact-form test, Google Business Profile hours/link check, before/after report; five business days after scope approval, payment, and access
- Care Essential ($79/month): uptime checks, routine maintenance, backup or recovery check, monthly report, 30 minutes of service time
- Larger scopes quoted after a free check: Tune-Up Plus ($699), Optimization Sprint ($1,199), Care Plus ($149/month), Care Priority ($299/month)

Important boundaries:
- BADGRTechnologies does not provide legal or compliance advice and does not promise search rankings or scores.
- Public forms are intended for business contact information only.
- Visitors should not submit PHI, patient records, medical details, passwords, or confidential information through public forms.
- BADGRTechnologies works on public-facing website pages only and does not handle patient data (ePHI).
